title: Lesson 3 · The context window: Claude's desk

scenes.text: Everything Claude can see at once fits on one desk. Here's what's on it.
Welcome to Claude Lab, by Curiously.
Last time, text became tokens. They have to sit somewhere.
That place is called the context window. Picture it as Claude's desk.
The mountain of text Claude learned from stays on the back wall. This desk holds only what's in front of Claude right now.
What goes on it? Your messages, any file you share, and every reply Claude writes.
Share a report and ask three questions. The report lands first. Every question and answer piles on top.
Claude doesn't wipe the desk between your messages. Each time you write, the whole chat so far comes along with it.
In 2023, Anthropic put all of The Great Gatsby on an early Claude's desk and changed one line. It found the change in twenty-two seconds.
Today, Claude's newest models have a desk of up to one million tokens. That's roughly five hundred fifty-five thousand words.
Big, but fixed. The desk doesn't grow as you chat. Only the pile on it does.
Every answer is worked out at that desk. So what happens when the desk is full?
In the next episode, we'll talk about why Claude forgets.
